pieces.content:
Filippo Morghen
Quelli che hanno appena rotto il vaso di fiori ('Tux'), Page. 147, 1803
Hand-colored copperplate engraving
11 × 8 in; 27.9 × 20.3 cm
pieces.readme: An alteration of a book print from a late 18th-century engraver—taking it from a floating classical figure, somewhat angelic, to a penguin (flightless and oily) who has just broken a vase, floating in a void.
pieces.title: Flower potting
